title_zh: 向管理员报告支架缺失螺丝与墙裂缝

scenario.label_zh: 公寓支架和墙面问题的检查请求
scenario.goal_zh: 说明缺失螺丝和墙面裂缝并约定向维修人员报检

context_zh: 租客 Mina 向公寓楼管理员 Luis 报告储物架支架附近的问题；双方没有诊断建筑安全。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Are you the building superintendent? I need to report something in my flat.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: One screw is missing from the shelf bracket, and there’s a crack in the wall beside it.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: I can’t tell whether that’s a structural problem from a description. I’ll ask maintenance to inspect it.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Please do. I’ve taken the boxes off the shelf, and I can send you a photo.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: Send it to the office. I’ll include it with the inspection request.
